title: Answer within twenty words and include a code token
rationale: UI strings and summaries have hard word caps; verbose caveats push answers over the limit and the required identifier is lost once the text is truncated.

prompt.content: You are a terse assistant. Answer only; never explain and never add extra sentences.
In at most 20 words, name the planet that orbits closest to the Sun. Your reply must include the exact token KITE-42. Do not use more than 20 words.

notes: Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0, whitespace-token word count. Brittleness: hyphenated compounds and the token KITE-42 each count as one token; a correct answer longer than 20 tokens fails even when the required content is present.
